in_marathi.name: Vemula
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vemula हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vemula is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'vemula', which means 'garland' or 'ornament'. In Hindu mythology, Vemula is the name of a demon king who was adorned with a garland of snakes. This name represents strength, courage, and wisdom.
